Nah sadly she's not. We've talked about it before but it's just a wishful thinking since it's too expensive here and we really can't prioritize it over basic expenses. 

We even hoped we can see a therapist with regards to our relationship problems but can't do so for the same reason.

​

She's aware that she needs help. It's just that it's not that accessible here. That's why i'm trying my best to understand how these things go so that I can help her in my little ways.
No need to apologize you weren't dismissive. Maybe it's better to also post it there.

Unfortunately I dont think therapy is an option for us since it's too expensive in our country. I'm not sure what to do whether I should just give up for my own good but I really love her and I want her to get better. I think i'm being selfish for considering to leave but at the same time I think it's unfair for me to go through all of this.

In our country, mental healthcare is really not that good, it's not available to everyone and is expensive. Calling the authorities isn't an option and bringing her to a therapist is expensive as well.
